result_status: Selected D1+newLFO+existing48k analog. Rejected fourfold analog as instrument default because of broad recording regression; retained component research only.

source_recording.redistribution: External local research capture; no redistribution license found; not bundled in shipping repository

protocol.data_status: All100 already-observed old PSS780 tour presets; descriptive reused regression, no new hardware holdout.
protocol.events: Full absolute video-time performance from zero; patch changes affect future notes only; no cropped-away context
protocol.event_order: At equal frames: program, prior note-offs, then stable note-ons; note-off frame=rounded onset+rounded gate
protocol.channel_policy: Both MIDI channels use the same program; channel IDs distinguish note-off matching

alignment.method: Globally whitened 12-bin STFT chroma; fixed harmonic MIDI chroma; global affine grid/differential evolution, no local warping.
caveats: Approximate chroma onset alignment depends on patch attack.
MIDI file identity is supported by description and global pitch progression; sender settings and channel routing remain unknown.
All source MIDI velocities are127; this does not independently verify hardware velocity processing.

protocol.latency: Remove reported nominal integer engine latency only; no local lag/phase/pitch search
protocol.recorded_chorus_epoch: Set native recorded-mode effect epoch to -reportedLatency/sampleRate, exactly compensating the later fixed-latency trim; legacy baseline retains its original epoch0

controls.recorded_mode: Full mix, global frozen v3 captured rate/depth from RecordedChorusProfile.h; no fit
controls.vibrato_and_sustain: Factory flags, identical to frozen offline behavior

protocol.stereo_metrics: Frozen v4 metrics: one pair gain,64log bands80-14000Hz and STFT512/2048/8192; no per-channel fit
protocol.effect_only: Observed M→S, third-order100–4000Hz zero-phase Butterworth, programbar+.25 to+1.5s; .2s context; no level/time/phase fit

actual_combined_analog.interpolator_and_decimator: two causal2x halfband FIR stages each way,129/65taps
actual_combined_analog.target: PSS480 volume-pot-top small-signal surrogate, not recovered exact PSS780 circuit/DAC

actual_selected_analog.target: Existing related-PSS480 surrogate; retained for better observed target-recording performance, not claimed exact PSS780 circuit.

lfo_only.role: selected instrument behavior, exact full-render identity verified against final production source

effect_only.status: Unchanged independent Recordedchorus transfer; not an improvement from FM/analog changes

limitations: No dry isolated exact-model reference or newly acquired hardware holdout in this run.
Existing MIDI arrangement alignment and program/tail policy are inferred; original patch/effect/capture state is incompletely known.
All three native models replay from the same absolute performance origin. D1/oldLFO resets phase per note; both new-LFO variants use continuous global phase0, not a recovered power-on/capture epoch.
The fourfold analog stage is a more accurate numerical integration of the same related-model surrogate, not an identification of the exact PSS780 board or YM3420 DAC.
Fourfold analog worsens75/100 joint-band scores and80/100 logSTFT scores against the LFO-only source; no broad measured recording improvement is supported.
Combined target-mean improvement is driven by MusicalSaw; BowedBass and HumanVoice1 joint-band scores are slightly worse than D1/oldLFO.
VDT retains the10ms/code hypothesis despite the pitch audit suggesting longer apparent delay.
The existing StereoRecorded transfer was calibrated to this old recording, so it is not independently evaluated here.
One RMS gain per stereo pair removes absolute gain evidence. The metric also removes each channel mean; no independent channel gain, onset, pitch, phase or per-preset parameter fitting is allowed.
Main native float output is finite but can exceed1 with limiter bypassed; exported auditions use a common safety gain and are unclipped.
No raw-core waveform parity was rendered in this recorded-only run. No additive noise is introduced.
Metrics are descriptive errors, not percentages of hardware fidelity or evidence of market superiority.
The fourfold analog experiment is rejected as an instrument default; the selected shipping behavior retains the existing48k analog stage and32frame declared latency.
